desc: Shadow Systems is now offering the CR920 Comp and Barrel Assembly as an upgrade for your existing CR920 pistol. This all-steel compensator is nitride coated for corrosion and wear resistance. This assembly is a drop in kit to allow the use of the QD Compensator Assembly from the CR920. The compensator is designed to align with the contours of your slide to create a seamless appearance on your pistol. The barrel that is included in this kit utilizes a Tri-Lug style attachment method for quick disassembly of the compensator.
